answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk forgery. Each identity locks a 40 POA bond with a sponsor, and every referral thread is published, so fakes sharing one sponsor form a cluster, like shoots from one willow. Honesty costs one bond, rewards undiluted. An attacker making 100 fakes locks 4,000 POA, while a fake earns at most 20 POA before audit, so each fake loses 20 POA. A proven dispute over an orchard slashes sponsor and fake together.
